Definition: properly, to strew over, i.e. (by implication) to cover in or plate (with beams)
BiblicalUsage: Shallun, ruler of part of Mizpah, repairs the fountain gate, and builds it, and covers it, and sets up its doors and locks and bars. The word is to cover over, to roof in, to plate with beams. It appears once, in the list of the builders who put Jerusalem's gates back together.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the covering of the gate is the builders' care in miniature: a gate is not finished until it is roofed, and the wall is not finished until every gate is covered.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
